title: Wireless Air-Quality Monitoring System
summary: Team capstone exploring low-cost wireless monitoring of ammonia, temperature, and humidity in agricultural environments.
description: Ongoing group capstone focused on sensor evaluation, embedded data acquisition, wireless communications, and environmental monitoring. Proposed approaches compare MOS and electrochemical ammonia sensing. Detailed implementation and results will be added after testing and approval to publish.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Design
summary: Arduino-based autonomous vehicle with motor control, sensors, and electronic circuit design.
description: Programmed an Arduino in C to control the vehicle's motors and sensors for autonomous navigation. Designed motor-power circuitry and created AutoCAD drawings related to the motor controller and vehicle power system.

title: Motor Reverse Engineering
summary: Disassembled and studied a motor, then recreated its components and mechanism in SolidWorks.
description: Collaborated with a team of five to analyze a physical motor and model its components. Created detailed parametric models, assembled the mechanism, and produced an animation showing the motor shaft's motion.

title: YouTube Interface & Data Workflow
summary: Built a YouTube-style frontend with HTML/CSS and worked on a Laserfiche API data workflow.
description: Developed a YouTube-inspired frontend using HTML and CSS. Also worked with NetBeans and the Laserfiche API on dataset filtering and file-management automation.
